# Mossgate devlog #12: we cut the crafting system

(Fictional project written for the grounding evaluation set. It does not exist.)

Hello everyone. It has been five weeks since the last update, which is longer than we promised. The short version is that we removed crafting from Mossgate and rebuilt the inventory around it.

## Why we cut it

In the October playtest, 14 of 19 players never opened the crafting menu after the tutorial. The players who did use it told us it felt like a second job. Crafting also accounted for roughly a third of our open bug reports.

## What changed

1. Crafting recipes are gone. Items that used to be crafted are now found in the world or bought from the two village traders.
2. The inventory went from 48 slots to 24 slots, and items of the same type now stack up to 10.
3. Tools no longer break. They get dull after about 40 uses and can be sharpened at any campfire.
4. We added a field journal that records every plant and creature you have seen.

## How it tested

We ran a small follow-up test with 8 players. Six of them finished the first region, compared with three of eight in the previous build. Two players said they missed crafting and asked for it back as an optional mode.

We have not decided whether an optional mode is worth the maintenance cost.

## What is next

- Rebalance the trader prices, which are currently too generous
- Finish the second region, which is about 60% complete
- Open a wider playtest in January with 200 keys; sign-ups will be posted on our forum

## A question for you

If you have played survival games without crafting, what kept you interested in exploring? We would like concrete examples, not praise.

Thanks for reading, and see you in devlog #13.
